recommendation: Keep this commit as-is. It is a narrow non-substantive correction in the active Device UDI link family, and no further core change is needed for FHIR-15566 unless a generated-link check finds another Device UDI hyperlink problem.
issue_request: FHIR-15566 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Device issue for STU3 reporting that section 8.14.1 Scope and Usage had a nonfunctional hyperlink to Unique Device Identifier (UDI); the approved resolution was to fix the link.
initial_application: The issue was pre-applied in git commit 801c2d12ffb45831ef24eb630cd668446346d300, which changed the old Scope and Usage UDI href from the invalid device.html# 8.14.3.2.3 target to #udi and added the corresponding udi anchor in Device notes.
additional_context: Device is active in the current build through source/fhir.ini. Current Scope and Usage links UDI to device.html#udi and Device notes define the udi anchor, so the original bad link is no longer present. Reconciliation found one adjacent current Device UDI narrative link still malformed as device-mappings.html#udi), while the parallel StructureDefinition comment already used device-mappings.html#udi. FHIR-13398 and FHIR-15774 are same-family historical Device UDI link issues; FHIR-15774 is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Changed source/device/device-notes.xml so the Device UDI Mapping href is device-mappings.html#udi instead of device-mappings.html#udi).
source_changes: source/device/device-notes.xml: corrected the Device UDI Mapping hyperlink target from device-mappings.html#udi) to device-mappings.html#udi.
